page_title: Learn to create a line chart using D3.js

sources.entry: Learn To Make A Line Chart

summary.title: Learn to create a line chart using D3.js
summary.one_liner: You learn to fetch JSON data from an API and render a labeled, axed line chart in an SVG element with D3.js v4.
takeaways: Load JSON from an external API with fetch after DOMContentLoaded and convert it into date/value objects.
Create an SVG group with margins, then set time and linear scales with domains from d3.extent.
Build a line generator with d3.line and draw it as an SVG path using datum and the d attribute.
Add bottom and left axes with d3.axisBottom and d3.axisLeft, including a 'Price ($)' label.
summary.summary: The tutorial builds a line chart of the Bitcoin Price Index for the past six months using D3.js, loaded from the CoinDesk historical API. It loads D3 v4 from a CDN into an HTML page with an SVG element, fetches and parses the data, and then draws the chart step by step. The steps cover the SVG container and margins, a translated group, time and linear scales, a d3.line generator, bottom and left axes, and finally a styled path for the line.
